title: Mode bar

options.label: A · Floating pill
options.about: A rounded pill floating over the bottom center, with text labels. Compact, and the squares run underneath it.

options.label: B · Tab bar
options.about: A full-width bar across the bottom with an icon and label for each mode, like a phone app. Takes its own strip of space.

options.label: C · Icon dock
options.about: A small floating dock of icons only. The name shows above the active or hovered one. Smallest footprint.

options.label: D · Text strip
options.about: A thin, quiet strip of small uppercase names with number keys, and an underline on the active mode. Feels like a tool.

question: Which bar should we build on?
about:
Four ways to do the mode bar along the bottom. The grey squares above are just stand-ins, and the five mode names (Grid, Feed, Canvas, Stack, Compare) are placeholders until we decide on the real modes.

Each bar works: click a mode, or press 1–5. Compare how much room each takes, whether you can see the mode names at a glance, and whether it feels like part of the page or something floating over it.

title: Focus mode

options.label: A · Strip
options.about: The square sits large in the middle, with a row of 8 variations underneath. Each variation is labelled with how it differs.

options.label: B · Compass
options.about: The square sits in the middle of a 3×3 grid. Left and right are smaller and bigger, up and down are lighter and darker. Arrow keys move you around.

options.label: C · Inspector
options.about: A big square on the left and a side panel with its properties and 6 options. Hover an option to compare its numbers with the current one.

options.label: D · Dials
options.about: Options change one thing at a time: a row that steps through size and a row that steps through shade, showing where you are in each.

question: Which Focus layout should we build?
about:
Focus is what you see after clicking a square in Canvas or Table: that square, big, with some other options next to it. Click an option to make it the new focus. The little trail by Back takes you to the ones you looked at before.

Compare how easy it is to see *how* each option is different, and how much room the properties take.

title: Canvas mode

options.label: A · Staggered
options.about: Like crescents: big cells, with every other column shifted down half a step. A calm, even wall.

options.label: B · Contact sheet
options.about: A tight, even grid that shows the most at once. Zoom in and each square gets a small caption.

options.label: C · Scattered
options.about: A loose moodboard: one big piece here, four medium ones there, a sprinkle of small ones elsewhere.

options.label: D · Seed clusters
options.about: Each original sits in the middle of a little island of its variations. Hover one to light up its whole family.

question: Which Canvas layout should we build?
about:
Canvas is the endless space you pan around, like crescents. Scroll or drag to move, pinch to zoom, and click a square to open it in Focus.

Compare how each one feels to wander through: calm and even, packed, loose, or grouped into families of variations.

title: Table mode

options.label: A · Spreadsheet
options.about: A classic sortable table with a small thumbnail on each row. The densest way to read the numbers.

options.label: B · Cards
options.about: A grid of cards with a big preview and the properties listed underneath. More picture, fewer rows.

options.label: C · Split preview
options.about: A list on the left and a big preview of whichever row you point at on the right. Arrow keys move through it.

options.label: D · Grouped
options.about: Outputs grouped by day, score or size, with headers you can fold away. Good once there are lots of them.

question: Which Table layout should we build?
about:
Table lists the outputs with their properties: seed, size, shade, score and when each was made. Click a column or chip to sort, and click an output to open it in Focus.

Compare how quickly you can scan the numbers versus see the squares themselves.

picked: A · Spreadsheet B · Cards C · Split preview D · Grouped
A · Strip B · Compass C · Inspector D · Dials

title: One top bar

options.label: A · Floating pill
options.about: A rounded pill at the top centre. The mode switch sits on the left and the pill grows to hold that mode's controls. In Focus it becomes a back arrow, the trail and a layout picker.

options.label: B · Toolbar
options.about: A slim strip across the full width, like a tool app: tabs on the left, the mode's controls in the middle, live details such as zoom or the number of outputs on the right. On a phone it becomes two rows.

options.label: C · Path
options.about: A quiet path in the top-left, like "GPS / Table / Grouped / by Day". Each part is a small menu, and clicking an earlier part takes you back. The most minimal of the three.

question: Which top bar should the app use?
about:
Three ways to fold the whole app into **one bar at the top** that changes shape with the mode. It replaces the bottom pill and the separate layout switches.

Try each one: switch between Canvas and Table, change layouts, then click a square to open Focus and press Back or Esc. Watch how the bar grows, shrinks and swaps its contents, and check it at phone width too.
